effect.name: GM Contour Engraver
effect.desc: Luminance-following engraved linework with relief shading, cross contours and metallic ink response.
effect.shader: float l(vec2 p){return dot(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(p,0.0,1.0)).rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0)),e=1.0/sz;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);float lum=l(uv),gx=l(uv+vec2(e.x,0))-l(uv-vec2(e.x,0)),gy=l(uv+vec2(0,e.y))-l(uv-vec2(0,e.y));float orient=atan(gy,gx)+1.5707963;vec2 dir=vec2(cos(orient),sin(orient));float phase=dot(uv,dir)*lineDensity+lum*curvature*8.0;float line=1.0-smoothstep(lineWidth,lineWidth+.08,abs(fract(phase)-.5));float cross=1.0-smoothstep(lineWidth,lineWidth+.08,abs(fract(dot(uv,vec2(-dir.y,dir.x))*lineDensity*.7)-.5));float ink=clamp(line*(1.0-lum)+cross*crossLines*(1.0-smoothstep(.1,.75,lum))+length(vec2(gx,gy))*relief,0.0,1.0);vec3 result=mix(paperColor.rgb,inkColor.rgb,ink);gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,result,mixAmount),src.a);}
